orders.judge: Hon'ble Mr. Justice Sharad Kumar Sharma
orders.text:
SA No. 121 of 2018 
Hon’ble Sharad Kumar Sharma, J.
Mr. Rajendra Dobhal, Senior Advocate 
assisted by Mr. Shubhang Dobhal, Advocate 
for the appellant. 
Mr. T.P.S. Takuli, Advocate accepts 
notice on behalf of respondent No. 1. 
Let notices be issued to respondent 
Nos. 2 to 5 by registered post A.D. 
List after receipt of the service report. 
The Second Appeal would stand 
admitted on the substantial question of law as 
contained in (i), (iii), (vi) and (vii). 
In the meantime, the parties are 
directed to maintain status quo qua the nature 
and title of the property, in question, till the 
next date of hearing. 
As far as damages are concerned, since 
the question raised is with regard to 
maintainability of the proceedings itself, the 
appellant, as an interim measure, would 
deposit 50% of the damages as awarded by 
the Court below before the Registry, which 
would kept in the form of F.D.R., and deposit 
thus made would abide by the decision of the 
Second Appeal. 
 
 (Sharad Kumar Sharma, J.)
Dated 14.11.2018 
Shiv

orders.judge: Hon'ble Mr. Justice Sharad Kumar Sharma
orders.text:
SA No. 121 of 2018
Hon’ble Sharad Kumar Sharma, J.
Mr. Rajendra Dobhal, Senior Advocate 
assisted by Mr. Shubhang Dobhal, Advocate for 
the appellants.
Dr. Kartikey Hari Gupta, Advocate for the 
respondents.
In compliance of the interim order dated 
14.11.2018, which was conditional in nature, 
directing the appellants to deposit 50% of the 
awarded amount, it is reported by the Registry 
that after the extension of time, which was 
granted by this Court on 01.07.2019, the 
appellants have deposited 50% of the awarded 
amount to the tune of Rs. 5,22,900/- before the 
Registry of this Court.
In that view of the matter, the condition, as 
imposed by the interim order dated 14.11.2018,
has been complied with.
The Urgency Application No. 10900/2019, 
as preferred by respondent No. 2 is being 
disposed of with direction that the Registry will 
list the matter for its final consideration upon 
receipt of the LCR, which is yet to be received by 
this Court.
List this matter after the LCR is received.
(Sharad Kumar Sharma, J.)
21.08.2019
